name: mwn-android
description: The MWN Android app. A Capacitor shell around the built web app in web/; the web app's source is a separate repository.

scripts.apk: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.release: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.apk:release: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.run:android: cap sync android && cap run android
